description: Demo presets recreating ui/card/carousel.html — one preset per distinct attribute combination on the host element. Furniture tokens (chip/sticker/save/play) are appended by the renderer from card content and never appear in preset.media.

carousel-default.name: Carousel Default
carousel-default.description: Column card, 4:3 carousel with default dots + arrows, large content scale

carousel-row.name: Carousel Row
carousel-row.description: Carousel as the media half of a row card

carousel-both.name: Carousel Both
carousel-both.description: Dots + arrows — bare nav, small content scale

carousel-plain.name: Carousel Plain
carousel-plain.description: Bare swipe scroller — nav(non); chip furniture comes from content

carousel-arrows-inverted.name: Carousel Arrows Inverted
carousel-arrows-inverted.description: Rounded-rect light circle, dark large full-arrow glyph

carousel-arrows-top.description: Edge arrows at the top — arw(top)

carousel-arrows-bottom.name: Carousel Arrows Bottom
carousel-arrows-bottom.description: Edge arrows at the bottom — arw(bot)

carousel-arrows-set.name: Carousel Arrows Set
carousel-arrows-set.description: Adjacent full-arrow pair, bottom end — arw(set) arw(arr) arw(bot)

carousel-bare-dark.name: Carousel Bare Dark
carousel-bare-dark.description: Black bare full-arrow for light images

carousel-xl.description: Extra-large arrows and dots — arw(xl) dot(xl)

carousel-band-set.name: Carousel Band Set

carousel-band-pills.name: Carousel Band Pills
carousel-band-pills.description: Pill timer bar in a surface-coloured band

carousel-band-autohide.name: Carousel Band Autohide
carousel-band-autohide.description: Band below with auto-hiding bare arrows — arw(hid)
